title: A review record survives a clean merge of main, and a conflicted merge after a fix check takes another fix check
why: merge --review-record refuses --fix-check when the newest earlier record already has a Fix check line, so a lane that merges main after its fix pass (PR #1186, head e304a0033) cannot record the merge's fix check. STALE-DECISION FLAG 18:20 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 18:16, relayed; triage read the two records and the rulings): decision standing-merge-grant line 18 ends "Each new head gets a fix verifier and a fresh review log." (line 19: runner 10 does the same); decision pr-review-record lines 16, 78 ("Owner's ruling": no fix check and no fresh review are owed), 82 and 130 say a clean merge of main takes none. Owner rulings: R1 (14:07 CST Nov 10: "i agree on letting it survive a clean merge where batch ci sees the problem rather than asecond review") against runner-merge-main-grant (owner "a" 13:12 CST Nov 13; item 806 d 23:40 CST Nov 13): the fix-verifier clause is in the drafted grant text, not in the quoted words, and item 806 as shown to him does not carry it. Whether he saw it is unknown, so no ruling settles it. Outcome both protect: a change merged into a reviewed PR is still checked; now protected by CI on the merge head and the tree proof. Cost of the stricter line as read (runner 10 on #3318, 18:1x): one fix verifier, one record and one lane lint per updated PR, serial; measured: none yet. Coordinator pick for #3318 only (undoable): the lane runs the fix verifier in parallel while runner 10 reads --reviewed; if the tool reads done, the lane stops. Put to the owner as page item 846 (pick-clean-merge-main-fix-verifier): a reword the grant line (widens), b reword the record (undoes R1), c leave both; no star.
note: Owner ruling 14:07 CST Nov 10 (typed in the retrospective session, relayed by the coordinator 14:08 CST): "i agree on letting it survive a clean merge where batch ci sees the problem rather than asecond review i agree it shd be mechanical tooo". A review record stays valid when the new head differs from the reviewed head only by a clean merge of main (no conflict, the lane's own diff unchanged); the merge tool proves it mechanically (git merge-tree or range-diff). Any other difference keeps today's rule. Home: rewrite decision pr-review-record in place (reconcile its line 111 with lines 67-73), on #2563. Step fix-check-chain folds in here: a conflicted merge after a PASS fix check takes one more fix check. Waiting: #1186 (e304a0033), #1805 (bee580d0a), #2534 (b9eec43ec), #2465 (474752554), #2431 (53c93b41b), #2268 (5b038da96); all had conflicted merges or a fix, so each still owes its fix check record. Filed by triage 13:00 CST Nov 10. Refusal text: 'the reviewed head must be the Head of the newest earlier review record on this pull request, and that record must have no Fix check line' (decision pr-review-record). Done when a merge-from-main fix check records against the prior record's head, with a test red on main. Coordinator 13:03 CST: build it with triage's agents; #1186 waits on it, and #2508 waits on #1186. Done when #1186's merge from main gets a record that `merge --reviewed` reads as done.
